prompt: Reference images 1-3 show only the drawing style: take from them the line work, colors, shading and simplicity, never their content or characters. Reference image 4 is the main character: keep exactly its head, face, colors, markings, body proportions; change only pose, action and expression. Its ear on the viewer's left is folded down and its ear on the viewer's right stands up, exactly as in the reference image, whichever way it turns; when the character is seen from behind, the folded ear is on the viewer's right. SCENE: tall vertical picture: a plain room. The main character sits on the floor, overwhelmed and startled, eyes wide, ears pressed back, one paw half raised, while a shower of many small plain blank paper notes and blank sticky notes falls on it from above, about twelve separate notes tumbling through the air apart from each other, two of them already resting on its head; right in front of it on the floor stands one low plain table with three dirty mugs with brown coffee rings, untouched. The flame on the tip of its tail is small and dim. LAYOUT: the main character is big and whole in the middle, filling most of the height from the floor to two thirds up; the falling notes are spread in the upper third and around the head, each note separate with clear gaps; the low table with the three mugs is in the lower right, apart from the character; the whole picture is softly coloured with watercolour; no letters or numbers anywhere. If the picture has no specific place, its background is plain near-white paper, even and untinted. Colours: black ink lines on cream paper in exactly the hand-drawn style of the style references, and most of the picture is gently coloured with soft transparent watercolour: the walls, the floor, the furniture and every object each get their own natural muted colour (warm beige walls, honey wooden floor, a soft blue sofa, pale yellow and white notes, cream mugs with brown coffee stains, a sage green kettle), light and airy, with the cream paper still glowing through; never neon, never acid-bright, never flat digital fills, never a single-colour picture. The main character stays black with green eyes, orange cheek marks and an orange tail flame. Every surface is clean and unmarked: blank paper, blank screens, plain envelopes, plain walls, unprinted floor. Keep the main subject well inside the frame, away from the edges. Draw everything in exactly the drawing style of the style references.
